responsibility: Implements GCC’s GIMPLE assumptions pass for front-end generated assume helper functions, currently used to realize C++23 assume semantics through the ranger/value-range infrastructure. It analyzes a special assume function’s single boolean return path, walks defining statements or PHIs backward with GORI/range queries to determine which SSA parameter ranges make the function return true, merges those parameter ranges, and records them as global range info on the helper’s default-def parameters so later IFN_ASSUME/inferred-range handling in other functions can import the assumptions during VRP and related simplification.
